poem.content:
In the depths of the earth, a tooth-like fragment lies
A fossil of a moment, worn by time's remembering sighs
The brief whisper of a ancient voice, a rumor of days past
Echoes through the silence, a haunting that will forever last

A saddle-worn saddleback, worn by the burden of time's weight
A testament to the trials that shaped this hard, unhewn slate
The armor of the earth, a shield against the ravages of old
A buffer against the tooth-like edges, where only rock and remnants hold

In the darkness, I uncover the truth, a hidden tale of ebb and flow
A cryptic code, an ancient language, begin to indicate its secrets to me, slowly
A test of faith, as the uncertainties unfold
A used landscape, worn and weary, where only echoes remain to be told

The wire-strewn terrain stretches out before me, a metallic sprawl
A landscape both desolate, and strange, devoid of life's gentle call
In this barren world, I search for a glimmer of hope
A dream of renewal, a green shoot bursting through the endless scope

But like a fossilized bone, the remnants of the past remain
A reminder of what was lost, forever trapped in this armor of stone
Yet still I retreat to the edge, where the jaw of the earth once did bite
And there I feel the tremors, the heartbeat of the ancient, wrestle within the sight

In the numb of twilight, a tube of lights cuts through the darkness like a spear
Spray of sparks, signaling a loss that was, and a future yet unclear
The depth of my soul, a stared-down challenge, once resisted now, submitted
And in this fashion, an armor-tough exterior, which once held strong its dent, just now began to permit its bracks.
